description.en: Generate CHANGELOG, release notes, and migration guide from Git commit history
description.de: CHANGELOG, Release Notes und Migrationsanleitung aus der Git-Commit-History generieren

instructions.de: Generiere Changelog, Release Notes und ggf. Migrationsanleitung aus der Git-History.
instructions.en: Generate a changelog, release notes and, if needed, a migration guide from the Git history.

command.de: Analysiere die Git-Commits. Kategorisiere jeden Commit: feat (neue Features), fix (Bugfixes), refactor, docs, test, chore, breaking (Breaking Changes). Gruppiere zusammengehoerige Commits. Identifiziere die 3 wichtigsten Aenderungen.
command.en: Analyze the Git commits. Categorize each commit: feat (new features), fix (bug fixes), refactor, docs, test, chore, breaking (breaking changes). Group related commits. Identify the 3 most important changes.

command.de: Erstelle CHANGELOG.md im Keep-a-Changelog Format fuer Version {{ new_version }}. Kategorien: Added, Changed, Fixed, Removed, Breaking Changes. Jeder Eintrag mit Commit-Hash.
command.en: Create CHANGELOG.md in Keep a Changelog format for version {{ new_version }}. Categories: Added, Changed, Fixed, Removed, Breaking Changes. Every entry with its commit hash.

config.else_command: echo "No breaking changes — migration guide not needed."
config.then_command: Create MIGRATION.md with a step-by-step migration guide for all breaking changes.

command.de: Erstelle RELEASE_NOTES.md fuer '{{ product_name }}' {{ new_version }}. Schreibe benutzerfreundlich (nicht technisch). Struktur: Was ist neu (mit Beispielen), Was wurde verbessert, Was wurde behoben, Upgrade-Hinweise.
command.en: Create RELEASE_NOTES.md for '{{ product_name }}' {{ new_version }}. Write in a user-friendly (non-technical) way. Structure: What's new (with examples), What was improved, What was fixed, Upgrade notes.
